name: static-binary-analysis
description: Static reverse engineering of any program file (native C/C++ PE, ELF, Mach-O, plus .NET, Java, APK) with call-level evidence, and a lab that patches a copy. .NET can be decompiled and rebuilt; native binaries are patched in place.

x-skyline.summary: Read any program file, then change a copy. Native C/C++ is patched in place; .NET can be decompiled and rebuilt.
